description_en: Calls InstantiateFabricChaincode to instantiate a chaincode
kebab_example: aliyun baas instantiate-fabric-chaincode --organization-id peers-aaaaaa2-1eqnj5o5w0000 --chaincode-id cc-198jejf8f80000 --endorse-policy 'OR_#39_perf9141MSP.member_#39' --location cn-hangzhou --collection-config requiredPeerCount_:0,_name_:_collectionName_,_maxPeerCount_:3,_blockToLive_:0,_policy_:_OR_Org1MSP.peer --region cn-hangzhou
name: InstantiateFabricChaincode

parameters.help_en:
The private data collection configuration:
- name: The name of the private data collection.
- maxPeerCount: The maximum number of peer nodes to which the private data collection can be distributed during the endorsement phase.
- requiredPeerCount: The minimum number of peer nodes to which the private data collection must be distributed during the endorsement phase for the transaction to be considered successful.
- blockToLive: The duration (in block height) for which private data is retained after the private transaction is committed to the blockchain. A value of 0 indicates permanent retention.
- policy: The peer nodes to which the private data collection is allowed to be distributed. The format is the same as the endorsement policy
parameters.help_zh:
隐私数据集配置：
- name：隐私集合名称
- maxPeerCount：该隐私集合在背书阶段最多分发到 N 个peer节点
- requiredPeerCount：该隐私集合在背书阶段至少需要被分发到N个peer节点上，才认为交易成功
- blockToLive：隐私交易上链后，隐私数据需要保留的时间（单位为区块高度），0 表示永久保存
- policy：该隐私集合被允许分发到哪些 peer 节点上，格式同背书策略
parameters.name: collection_config
